task.description:
Write a test spec and integration test code for API-03 (Instance management).

API-03 added two new endpoints to src/api/routes/instances.zig:
1. GET /instances/:id — handleGetById
2. GET /instances — handleList (paginated, filterable by status and definition_id)

The existing POST /instances (handleCreate) and POST /instances/:id/cancel (handleCancel) already have tests.

Write:
1. tests/specs/API-03.md — test spec with test cases for both new endpoints covering:
   - 200 success responses with correct payload shape
   - 404 NOT_FOUND for GET /instances/:id with unknown ID
   - 422 INVALID_INSTANCE_ID for malformed UUID
   - 409 cases (CANCELLED instance — should still return 200 with status=CANCELLED, not 409)
   - Pagination: first page, cursor-based next page, expired cursor (410)
   - Filtering: by status, by definition_id, combined filters
   - Auth: any authenticated role can access (PROCESS_OPERATOR token)
2. Integration test cases in tests/integration/ following the pattern of existing integration tests

Read the design artefact at src/design/api-03-instance-management.md for complete error taxonomy and response shapes.
acceptance_criteria: tests/specs/API-03.md exists with test cases for GET /instances/:id and GET /instances
Integration tests cover happy path, 404, 422, pagination, and filtering
Test code compiles (zig build test exits 0 where applicable)
Test spec references correct error codes from the design artefact

result.summary: Test specs and test code for API-03 (GET /instances/:id and GET /instances). Created tests/specs/API-03.md (21 test cases), tests/unit/api03_handler_test.zig (9 deterministic unit tests, all passing), tests/integration/api03_instance_read_test.zig (12 integration tests, compilation verified). Fixed pre-existing Zig 0.16 build blocker in src/api/routes/instances.zig (std.time.nanoTimestamp not available; replaced with OS-native currentMicrosecondTimestamp helper). zig build test exits 0.

issues.description: Fixed pre-existing blocker: src/api/routes/instances.zig used std.time.nanoTimestamp() (Zig 0.15 API removed in 0.16). Replaced with currentMicrosecondTimestamp() using RtlGetSystemTimePrecise on Windows / clock_gettime on POSIX.
